direction_source: Studio direction on study 0005, refined in Codex
construction: The inherited path is rotated as one rigid presentation so its endpoint direction reads upward. A butterfly is fixed to the path, its body aligned to each transition and its wings lateral to that body. Each original state carries exactly one alternating wing pose. Position and wing angle use the same ease-in/ease-out interpolation between adjacent states.
invariants: the 64 source coordinates and their order
one wing pose per original state
no drift and no inserted path or wing states
rigid cube and path distances under presentation rotation
changes: continuous progress within the selected original transition
ease-in/ease-out position along that straight segment
ease-in/ease-out wing angle between its two endpoint poses
camera orbit and optional cube rotation

motion_contract.position: smoothstep(t) on the current inherited straight segment
motion_contract.wings: smoothstep(t) between the two wing poses attached to the segment's source states

limits: This is a kinematic reading of the deterministic path, not a biological flight simulation.
